definitions.explanation: Any facility that provides medical care, including hospitals, clinics, and specialized treatment centers. A formal term used in official, medical, and news contexts.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{医療|いりょう}{機関|きかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please visit a nearby medical facility.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{医療|いりょう}{機関|きかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: There are few medical facilities in this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{速|すみ}やか→速やか：15283_sumiyaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{医療|いりょう}{機関|きかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{診察|しんさつ}→診察：03259_shinsatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{勧|すす}め→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If symptoms persist, we recommend that you promptly seek examination at a medical facility.

notes:
A formal compound of ⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧ (medical care) and ⟦{機関|きかん}→機関：02630_kikan⟧ (institution, agency). This is the standard term used in government documents, news reports, and health advisories to refer collectively to hospitals, clinics, and other healthcare providers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {医療|いりょう}{機関|きかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to visit a medical facility
- ⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧{医療|いりょう}{機関|きかん}: designated medical institution
- ⟦{救急|きゅうきゅう}→救急：15075_kyuukyuu⟧{医療|いりょう}{機関|きかん}: emergency medical facility
- {医療|いりょう}{機関|きかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧: shortage of medical facilities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧: hospital — a specific type of medical facility, more everyday
- ⟦クリニック→クリニック：08941_kurinikku⟧: clinic — a smaller, outpatient medical office
- ⟦{診療所|しんりょうじょ}→診療所：14205_shinryoujo⟧: clinic, dispensary — formal term for a small medical practice

USAGE:
Commonly seen in public health announcements, news during disease outbreaks, and government health policy documents. It is broader than ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧ and covers any facility that provides medical services.
